en: The postcard shows a scenic waterfall with a series of large baskets attached to poles above the water, likely traditional fishing equipment. At the top, the text is split into two languages: on the left, in Latvian, it reads 'Kuldīga, Uhdenskrītums 'Rumba''; on the right, in German, 'Goldingen, Windauwasserfall (Die Rummel)'. The landscape is natural with the focus on the waterfall and unusual basket contraptions for river fishing.
